title: A deterministic multiple-shift lattice algorithm for function approximation in Korobov and half-period Cosine spaces
summary: Approximating multivariate periodic functions in weighted Korobov spaces via rank-1 lattices is fundamentally limited by frequency aliasing. Existing optimal-rate methods rely on randomized constructions or large pre-computations. We propose a fully deterministic multiple-shift lattice algorithm without pre-computation. First, we develop a simplified multiple shift framework for aliased frequency fibers that reduces sampling costs.
